Class RoleEmailCsvService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.RoleEmailCsvService
@Service public class RoleEmailCsvService extends Object
Bulk upload of email addresses into one of the role tables, from a CSV file.

Written for the instructors upload endpoint, and once shared with the grad students one, so any later role table behaves identically rather than merely similarly. The caller supplies only what differs: how to tell whether an address is already present, and how to store a new one.

The file must have a header row containing a column named email (case-insensitive); any additional columns are ignored, except one the caller may name as carrying an extra value for each row (the instructors upload uses catalogName, issue #172). Rows are processed independently: an address already present is a no-op rather than an error, and a malformed row is skipped and reported rather than aborting the rows that already succeeded. Re-uploading the same file is therefore safe.

  • Method Details

    • upload

      public RoleEmailCsvService.UploadResult upload(org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file, String optionalColumn, Predicate<String> exists, BiConsumer<String,String> save, BiConsumer<String,String> updateExisting) throws IOException, com.opencsv.exceptions.CsvException
      Reads the file and stores each valid, not-yet-present address, passing along the row's value of one optional column (issue #172).
      Parameters:
      optionalColumn - header name of a column whose value accompanies each address; matched like email (case-insensitive, whitespace-tolerant), null when the file lacks the column or the cell is blank
      exists - whether the address is already in the target table
      save - stores a new address and its optional value; called only for valid, absent addresses
      updateExisting - called instead of save for a valid address already present (still counted as already present), so the optional value can be applied to it
      Throws:
      IOException
      com.opencsv.exceptions.CsvException
